Java Lesson 1 - Hello World
assignments.description:
Complete after doing the Hello World lesson on Codecademy. The goal of this lesson is to learn how to create workspaces in VSCode, run java projects, and submit assignments on Classroom50. Connor will walk you through cloning the repository that is created when you accept this assignment.

Your task:
Print "Hello <your name>" to the console.

assignments.name: Java Lesson 2 -- Variables
assignments.description:
Your Task:
Save the following information in Variables. Think about what data type each variable should use, and use understandable names for each one (ex. Don't name your age variable "Bob"; name it "age"). Then, print out each of your variables.
- Your name
- Your age
- Whether you're right or left handed (Don't use a String)
- Hours of sleep last night (use decimals if applicable)

assignments.name: Java Lesson 3 - Manipulating Variables
assignments.description:
Complete after doing the Manipulating Variables lesson on Codecademy. In this assignment, you will use variables and mathematical operators to make calculations. The goal is to practice changing variables and using Java to solve simple mathematical problems.

Template: Main class with the main method

Your task:
Create a program that calculates the cost of buying several items. Choose three items and save the price of each item in a variable. Then calculate and print:
- The total cost before tax
- The amount of sales tax
- The final cost after tax
- The average price of the three items
Use variables and mathematical operators to do all of the calculations. Do not calculate the answers yourself and just print the final numbers.
